The '''4.2 VMT Power Converter''' was a [[Power converter/Legends|power converter]] manufactured by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]]. 4.2 VMTs were installed aboard the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].
